name: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd
about: The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of bead wire, a high-carbon steel wire utilized in the production of tires. Additionally, the Company produces drawn steel wire, commonly referred to as black wire, which finds applications in various industries such as automobile, construction, and engineering. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Offerings
a) Tyre Bead wire: Bead wire is a drawn steel wire manufactured from high-carbon wire rods and coated with copper or bronze. It is used in all types of automobile tyres, as well as tyres for earth-moving equipment and aircraft. The primary function of bead wire is to secure the tyre to the rim and withstand the pressure exerted by inflation. [1]

cons: Dividend payout has been low at 13.8% of profits over last 3 years
